title: Scalar-compatible comparison morphisms transfer point-section transports and rationalization
statement:
Fix the finite-field datum $p,a,q,k_0,k$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime $\ell\ne p$, and an algebraic closure $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$. Let $s=\operatorname{Spec}k$ and let $g:s\to s$ be any scheme automorphism [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Work on its small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. For each finite coefficient field $F\subset\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$, let $\mathcal O_F$ be its valuation ring with a chosen uniformizer [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], put $R_F=\widehat{\mathcal O}_{F,s}$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients], and write $G_F=g^{-1}$ with the $R_F$-action transported through $c_F^{-1}$ [def-weil-inverse-image-pullback-comparison]. Sections $\Gamma(s,-)$ are termwise sections passed to derived categories [lem-weil-point-proetale-sections-exact].

For each such field $F$, put $\mathcal D_F=D^b_c(s,\mathcal O_F)$ [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed] and let $J_F:\mathcal D_F\to\mathcal D_F$ be an $\mathcal O_F$-linear functor. For each finite inclusion $F\subset F'$, use integral extension $T_{F'/F}$ [def-weil-integral-scalar-extension], the sections comparison $\varphi$ and its integral associator $A$ of [lem-weil-point-sections-scalar-extension], the module associator $a^{\mathrm{mod}}:(N\otimes_{\mathcal O_E}\mathcal O_L)\otimes_{\mathcal O_L}\mathcal O_M\xrightarrow{\sim}N\otimes_{\mathcal O_E}\mathcal O_M$, $((n\otimes a)\otimes b)\mapsto n\otimes ab$, of that node, and the specified comparison $\beta:T_{F'/F}G_F\to G_{F'}T_{F'/F}$ of [lem-weil-isomorphism-comparison-scalar-extension]. For $H\in\mathcal D_F$ the object $G_FH$ is constructible and derived complete [lem-weil-isomorphism-derived-pullback], so $\varphi$ and $\beta$ are defined at it. Suppose given natural isomorphisms $\delta_{F'/F,H}:T_{F'/F}J_FH\xrightarrow{\sim}J_{F'}T_{F'/F}H$. They are the identity for $F'=F$, under the unit identifications, and for every $E\subset L\subset M$ they satisfy
$$\delta_{M/E,H}A_{J_EH}=J_M(A_H)\delta_{M/L,T_{L/E}H}T_{M/L}(\delta_{L/E,H}).$$
Let $u^F_H:G_FH\to J_FH$ be morphisms, not assumed natural in $H$, satisfying for all inclusions and all $H\in\mathcal D_F$
$$\delta_{F'/F,H}T_{F'/F}(u^F_H)=u^{F'}_{T_{F'/F}H}\beta_{F'/F,H}.$$
Write $\sigma^{g,F}$ for [lem-weil-point-automorphism-restriction-natural]. Assume for all inclusions and all $H\in\mathcal D_F$ the inverse-image sections square
$$\varphi_{F'/F,G_FH}\Gamma(s,\beta_{F'/F,H})^{-1}\sigma^{g,F'}_{T_{F'/F}H}=(\sigma^{g,F}_H\otimes1)\varphi_{F'/F,H}.$$
Set $v^F_H=\Gamma(s,u^F_H)\sigma^{g,F}_H$ and $\zeta_{L/E,H}=\varphi_{L/E,J_EH}\Gamma(s,\delta_{L/E,H})^{-1}$. Then for all $E\subset L$ and $H\in\mathcal D_E$,
$$\zeta_{L/E,H}v^L_{T_{L/E}H}=(v^E_H\otimes1)\varphi_{L/E,H}.$$
The comparisons themselves satisfy $\zeta_{E/E,H}=\mathrm{id}$ under the unit identifications and
$$\zeta_{M/E,H}\Gamma(s,J_MA_H)=a^{\mathrm{mod}}(\zeta_{L/E,H}\otimes1)\zeta_{M/L,T_{L/E}H}.$$

Put $q_F(N)=N\otimes_{\mathcal O_F}F$ and let $\rho_{L/E,N}:q_L(N\otimes_{\mathcal O_E}\mathcal O_L)\xrightarrow{\sim}q_E(N)\otimes_E L$ be exactly the coefficient-complex rationalization comparison of [lem-weil-coefficient-complex-rationalization], with value $((n\otimes a)\otimes b)\mapsto(n\otimes1)\otimes ab$. Define $\varphi^{\mathrm{rat}}_{L/E,H}=\rho_{L/E,\Gamma(s,H)}q_L(\varphi_{L/E,H})$, $\zeta^{\mathrm{rat}}_{L/E,H}=\rho_{L/E,\Gamma(s,J_EH)}q_L(\zeta_{L/E,H})$, and $v^{F,\mathrm{rat}}_H=q_F(v^F_H)$. In $D(L)$ one has
$$\zeta^{\mathrm{rat}}_{L/E,H}q_L(v^L_{T_{L/E}H})=(v^{E,\mathrm{rat}}_H\otimes_E1_L)\varphi^{\mathrm{rat}}_{L/E,H}.$$
These are the rationalizations of the specified integral comparisons. The integral transport square and the rational square obey identity and successive-extension compatibility using exactly $A$, $a^{\mathrm{mod}}$ and the mixed integral/field tower equation of $\rho$. They hold in the raw rationalized categories [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi], including fraction-valued morphisms, without idempotent completion or any naturality assumption on $v^F$ or $u^F$.

proof.text: Write $S_F=\Gamma(s,-)$ and write composites right to left. By [lem-weil-point-proetale-sections-exact], $S_F$ is a functor on derived categories. Its action is $\mathcal O_F$-linear, since termwise sections sends multiplication by a constant scalar to that same multiplication. The hypotheses give $J_FH\in\mathcal D_F$, and [lem-weil-isomorphism-derived-pullback] gives $G_FH\in\mathcal D_F$. Thus all applications of the natural isomorphism $\varphi$ and its specified tower equation in [lem-weil-point-sections-scalar-extension] are legitimate, including at the derived arrow $u^E_H:G_EH\to J_EH$. No representative of this arrow as a chain map is required.

proof.text:
For $E\subset L\subset M$ abbreviate $T=T_{L/E}$, $U=T_{M/L}$, $e=\delta_{L/E,H}$, $d=\delta_{M/L,TH}$ and $D=\delta_{M/E,H}$. Inverting and rearranging the assumed $\delta$ tower gives
$$D^{-1}J_M(A_H)=A_{J_EH}U(e^{-1})d^{-1}.$$
Use the $\varphi$ tower of [lem-weil-point-sections-scalar-extension] at $J_EH$, and then its naturality for $e^{-1}:J_LTH\to TJ_EH$:
$$\begin{aligned}
\zeta_{M/E,H}S_M(J_M A_H)
&=\varphi_{M/E,J_EH}S_M(A_{J_EH})S_M(Ue^{-1})S_M(d^{-1})\\
&=a^{\mathrm{mod}}(\varphi_{L/E,J_EH}\otimes1)\varphi_{M/L,TJ_EH}S_M(Ue^{-1})S_M(d^{-1})\\
&=a^{\mathrm{mod}}((\varphi_{L/E,J_EH}S_L(e^{-1}))\otimes1)
  \varphi_{M/L,J_LTH}S_M(d^{-1})\\
&=a^{\mathrm{mod}}(\zeta_{L/E,H}\otimes1)\zeta_{M/L,TH}.
\end{aligned}$$
The unit statements for $\delta$ and $\varphi$ give $\zeta_{E/E,H}=\mathrm{id}$ under the stipulated unit identifications.

source.place: First transport arrow: target comparison tower, psi-prime part of returned step 6.

proof.text:
The successive-extension compatibility of the transport squares follows by pasting their actual equations. Apply Step 2 for $M/L$ at $TH$ and tensor its $L/E$ equation with $\mathcal O_M$. Step 3 and the $\varphi$ tower of [lem-weil-point-sections-scalar-extension] give
$$\begin{aligned}
\zeta_{M/E,H}S_M(J_M A_H)v^M_{UTH}
&=a^{\mathrm{mod}}(\zeta_{L/E,H}\otimes1)(v^L_{TH}\otimes1)\varphi_{M/L,TH}\\
&=(v^E_H\otimes1_M)\varphi_{M/E,H}S_M(A_H).
\end{aligned}$$
Here the second equality uses naturality of the module associator at the single module-derived arrow $v^E_H$. The direct $M/E$ square, precomposed by $S_M(A_H)$, has exactly the same right side. Since $\zeta_{M/E,H}$ is invertible, this also proves
$$S_M(J_M A_H)v^M_{UTH}=v^M_{T_{M/E}H}S_M(A_H).$$
Thus no unstated naturality of $v$ at $A_H$ is used. For an identity extension the two sides of Step 2 are the same arrow under the given units; this proves identity compatibility as well.

source.place: First transport arrow: identity and successive-extension compatibility of the transferred square.

proof.text:
By [lem-weil-coefficient-complex-rationalization], $q_F$ and field scalar extension are functors on derived categories, and the specified $\rho$ is natural for every derived arrow. Apply $q_L$ to Step 2 and postcompose with $\rho_{L/E,S_EJ_EH}$. Its naturality at $v^E_H:S_EH\to S_EJ_EH$ says
$$\rho_{L/E,S_EJ_EH}q_L(v^E_H\otimes1)
=(q_E(v^E_H)\otimes_E1_L)\rho_{L/E,S_EH}.$$
Substitution gives precisely
$$\zeta^{\mathrm{rat}}_{L/E,H}q_L(v^L_{TH})
=(v^{E,\mathrm{rat}}_H\otimes_E1_L)\varphi^{\mathrm{rat}}_{L/E,H}.$$
The definitions here use the specified $\rho((n\otimes a)\otimes b)=(n\otimes1)\otimes ab$; none of the comparisons has been replaced by an arbitrary isomorphism.

source.place: First transport arrow: rationalized transport square, returned step 7.

proof.text:
For a tower, apply $q_M$ to Step 3 and to the pasted equation of Step 4. Use the mixed integral/field tower equality of [lem-weil-coefficient-complex-rationalization], first at $S_EH$ and then at $S_EJ_EH$. It replaces the direct comparison $\rho_{M/E}q_M(a^{\mathrm{mod}})$ by the successive $\rho_{M/L}$, $\rho_{L/E}\otimes_L M$, and field associator, in that order. Naturality of $\rho$ at the arrows in those equations then gives
$$\zeta^{\mathrm{rat}}_{M/E,H}q_M S_M(J_M A_H)
=a^{\mathrm{fld}}(\zeta^{\mathrm{rat}}_{L/E,H}\otimes_L1_M)\zeta^{\mathrm{rat}}_{M/L,TH},$$
and the identical pasting equation for the rational transport squares. The analogous equation for $\varphi^{\mathrm{rat}}$ follows from the cited $\varphi$ tower. The unit equation of $\rho$ gives the rational units. This checks the specified associators, including their order, rather than merely asserting coherence.

source.place: First transport arrow: rationalized target tower and transport-square pasting, returned step 7.

proof.text:
Use the raw Hom tensors of [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi]. The functors $J_F$ extend because they are linear; integral coefficient extension is semilinear. Their natural comparisons extend by [lem-pur-semilinear-scalar-localization], with the coefficient inclusions sending each uniformizer to an invertible field element. The sections realization on raw Hom tensors is explicitly
$$\sum_i f_i\otimes a_i\longmapsto\sum_i a_i\,q_F(S_F(f_i)),$$
and similarly with $S_FJ_F$ in place of $S_F$. These maps are balanced because $S_F,J_F$ are linear; they preserve identities and composition by expansion and bilinearity. They are independent of fraction presentations, without needing injectivity on integral Hom groups. Naturality of the comparisons for an arrow $f/\varpi_F^n$ is its integral naturality equation multiplied by $\varpi_F^{-n}$, and for a finite sum it is the sum of these equations. Thus all comparison equations used above remain valid for fraction-valued morphisms. The components $u^F_H,v^F_H$ are simply sent to their $q_F$ images: no extension as a natural transformation is asserted for either family. Objects in the raw localization are the same integral objects, so Steps 5--6 apply to all of them; no idempotent splitting is involved.
